name: sister_search
description: The Magus Sisters' target search (the native btlGetCommandTargetSearch, 0x7A37E0, composed from 0x7A8B40 the usable set with the MP test, 0x7A8AD0 the chance roll with the standing order, 0x7A8F60 the filtered pick) on the real code: a sister asks for a command with a targeting code T, a property P (negated when F is 128) and a chance C; the answer is the usable mask, whether the roll passed, the picked slot (255 for none) and the stored target mask; every draw's stream is recorded.

function.signature: usable = 0x7a8b40(actor, cmd, T); roll = 0x7a8ad0(cmd, C); slot = 0x7a8f60(actor, cmd, -16, P, 0, F)

harness.note: search: the real machine code of the functions in an x86-32 emulator with the battle generator scripted; handlers: the sister workers of the battle-system script on the game VM, natives answered by a Python world (the chance roll, the search as an oracle, the gain calls, the standing-order store, the command buffer, performCommand); the game is never run

notes: A stratified subset (every 80th) of the 24,000 vectors of research/re-ffx-zanmato-and-orders.md section 15.1 (seed 20261017, the same draw order); the sisters are slots 15 to 17 (the only characters in the battle besides the monsters, slots 20 to 23 when present).
`in.row` is the command record the real lookup returned: Cmd+0x1a/0x1b as `u1a`, the silence bit of the flag word, the MP cost byte and the Overdrive-cost byte.
The characters' counters (shell, protect, reflect, haste, the four Nuls, silence) are the raw bytes; `extra` is the extra-status word (bit 9 Auto-Life, bit 10 Curse).
